summary.heading: Summary
summary.howScoredBody: The AI interviewer scores each answer against the role, then checks it for clarity, relevance and depth. Use the score as a starting point for your decision, not a replacement for it.
summary.howScoredYours: The AI interviewer scores each answer against the role, then checks it for clarity, relevance and depth. Employers see the same scores, so the areas to improve are a good place to start.

chapters.match: How closely their profile and answers fit this role.
chapters.communication: How clearly and confidently they explained their thinking.
chapters.types: Scores for each kind of question they answered.
chapters.insights: What stood out, and where to dig deeper.
chapters.recording: Watch the interview to hear it in their own words.
chapters.profile: Experience, education and links from their profile.
chapters.answers: Every question, their answer and how it was assessed.
